The same court annulled last year’s election in which Georgescu won the first round. The decision to cancel the election was made two days before the Dec. 8 runoff. In a Facebook video on Tuesday night, Georgescu, who is under judicial control and has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, suggested supporters could choose another candidate to back in the re-run election in May. “If you want ...
